rounds.response:
Below is a compact planning canvas for each workstream—each line shows (1) a one‑sentence working objective, (2) 3–5 example initiatives with quick tags ([ExtStory]=supports external messaging, [Risk: yes/no]=likely to change data/consent/approvals, [Support: top themes]=which ticket themes it reduces, [Eng: bounded]=engineering is a realistic, scoped change), and (3) open questions/assumptions to validate. 

Fast‑Value Activation — Objective: shorten time-to-first-meaningful-value for priority segments/roles (e.g., Admins, Integrators) directly after contract; Initiatives: 1) Role-based starter packs + sample data + one‑click deploy (ExtStory; Risk:no; Support: reduces "I didn’t realize" + provisioning tickets; Eng:bounded), 2) Guided in‑app activation flow + owner checklist + activation SLA (ExtStory; Risk:no; Support: reduces ownership/status questions), 3) Quick integration adapters + integration health telemetry (ExtStory; Risk: may touch credentials—Risk:review; Support: reduces integration-failure tickets), 4) Activation success telemetry + auto‑escalation for stalled accounts (ExtStory; Risk:no; Support: reduces stalled/provisioning tickets; Eng:bounded); Open questions/assumptions: which segments/roles to prioritize, target time window (e.g., 14 vs 30 days), what integrations/credentials we can automate under current controls.

Guidance & Expectations — Objective: remove “scary” language and set clear, role-based expectations so customers know who does what and when; Initiatives: 1) Welcome playbook + role-based checklists + templated comms (ExtStory; Risk:no), 2) Revise consent/contract and in‑product copy to be plain‑language and less alarming (ExtStory; Risk: wording-only changes—legal review recommended), 3) Customer-facing onboarding timeline/status page and simple SLA summary (ExtStory; Risk:no; Support: reduces status-check and expectation tickets), 4) Marketing package for external story: “what changed and why it’s better” (ExtStory; Risk:no); Open questions/assumptions: which consent/contract phrases require formal legal review, what existing content can be reused, and preferred channels/timing for comms.

Platform & Automation — Objective: reduce brittle manual handoffs and provide reliable operational visibility for customers and internal teams; Initiatives: 1) Automate approval gates where policy permits + audit trail (ExtStory; Risk: yes—formal Risk review required), 2) Lightweight account-state API + customer/internal provisioning dashboard (ExtStory; Risk:no; Support: reduces provisioning/status tickets; Eng:bounded), 3) Telemetry/alerts for stalled accounts and integration healthchecks (ExtStory; Risk:no; Support: reduces stalled/integration tickets; Eng:bounded), 4) Small auto-provision pilot for common configs for prioritized segments (ExtStory; Risk: depends on data—Risk review); Open questions/assumptions: which approval gates are automatable under current policy, required SLA/alert thresholds, and 60–90 day engineering capacity for a pilot.

If this framing works I’ll turn each stream into a one‑pager (scope, proposed success metrics, and suggested leads); please flag edits and nominate a Product/Eng/Risk/Marketing/Support lead for each stream by EOD Friday.

rounds.response:
Proposed 3‑phase 8–12 week strawman for leadership (phase narrative + 3–5 example items tagged as discovery/quick win/pilot, with notes on content vs data/approval changes and Risk review where needed):  
Phase 1 (Weeks 0–2) — "Make onboarding clearer and more guided": Welcome playbook + role‑based checklists (quick win; content-only; reduces "I didn’t realize" tickets); consent/in‑product copy edits (quick win; content-only but Legal/Risk review recommended); simple customer-facing onboarding status page (quick win; content+UI; reduces status-check/provisioning tickets); basic activation telemetry + stalled-account alerts (discovery/quick win; Eng: bounded; reduces stalled tickets).  
Phase 2 (Weeks 3–8) — "Experiment to accelerate first meaningful value": role‑based starter packs with sample data (pilot; content+config; reduces "I didn’t realize" & provisioning tickets); guided in‑app activation flow + owner checklist (pilot; content+UX; reduces ownership/status questions); quick integration adapters + integration health telemetry (pilot/discovery; Eng: bounded; Risk: may touch credentials — formal Risk review if credential/storage handling changes); activation success telemetry + auto‑escalation (pilot; Eng: bounded; reduces stalled accounts).  
Phase 3 (Weeks 6–12) — "Automate repeatable gates and scale": lightweight account‑state API + customer/internal dashboard (pilot; Eng: bounded; content-only re: consent), automate approval gates where policy permits (pilot; changes approvals — formal Risk review required), small auto‑provisioning pilot for common configs (pilot; may change data/handling — Risk review), expand telemetry/SLAs and ops runbook (quick win; Eng: bounded).  
Next step: I’ll draft a one‑pager per phase with proposed owners, rough effort bands, and 2–3 success metrics unless you ask for a different sequencing — please flag any items to move earlier and nominate leads by EOD Friday.
